description: This file contains the definition of the TalkModeController class, which manages the state and behaviors related to 'talk mode' in the application, including enabling/disabling, updating phases and levels, pausing, stopping speech, and exiting talk mode.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle and state of the talk mode feature, including toggling, phase updates, pausing, and speaking control.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, presenting or dismissing the overlay and updating runtime states accordingly.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current talk mode phase and communicates the change to external systems.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the talk mode, updating relevant states and notifying the system.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops speech output in talk mode with an optional reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Disables talk mode, effectively exiting the feature.
